exposure: Maternal reasons for not initiating breastfeeding (e.g., lack of milk secretion)
cohort: 227 mothers of infants aged 0-12 months attending the Department of Pediatrics at Adesh Medical College and Hospital in Haryana, India.
finding: Breastfeeding and complementary feeding practices were suboptimal, with only 49.8% of mothers initiating breastfeeding as the first feed, 31% practicing exclusive breastfeeding for six months, and 79.3% introducing complementary feeding before six months; lack of milk secretion was the most common reason for not initiating breastfeeding.
cross-section timing: When the infants were between 0 and 12 months of age.
